title_formula_note: Chosen T9, the creative director's new skeleton 'Why [Predator] Kills Everything [in Place] Except [Doug]' (brief 021 section 1, confirmed in decisions.md; approved like T7 for 011 and T8 for 018). Checked against Titler rules: (1) 50 chars, 9 words; (2) Title Case, no caps/emoji/!/?; (3) T9 approved by the CD as a new skeleton; (4) exactly one death verb, 'Kill', no dread adjective; (5) scope device 'Everything'; (6) no 'in N Minutes', no leading count; (7) thumbnail text must avoid every title and alt word (proposal A text 'NOT ME?' is clear); (9) 5 candidates; (10) no Paint Explainer title reused or noun-swapped. Not OctoLab wording: no 'Refuse(s) to Kill', no 'Deadliest Predator', no 'Killer Whales' alone, no captive names. T1 and T2 avoided per the 10-17 memo, and the formula differs from 020 (T6) and 019 (T4). Doug is in the title. Honest: 11 prey animals, rising to the blue whale, with the 'except Doug' answer built up item by item and paid off at the end (attributed learned-diet thesis plus the 2025 prey-offering study). Alternates: T9 'Except You' (the 'you' variant, 1.36x in the style bible; the video's claim is about people, with Doug standing in, so it is honest too; the best A/B test against the lead); T7 family 'Every Animal Orcas Kill, and the One They Won't' (scope 'Every', death verb 'Kill'); T4 'The Creepiest Orca Habit Scientists Found Is Feeding People' (revelation clause, pays off the closing 34-case study); T3 'The Most Disturbing Orca Hunts in Every Part of the Ocean' (the hunts span the North Pacific, Aleutians, New Zealand, South Africa, Gulf of California and Australia). Rejected: 'Nothing Is Safe From Orcas, Except Doug' (no dread word or death verb, rule 4); 'The Deadliest Predator in the Ocean Has One Exception' (copies a competitor's phrase 'The Deadliest Predator in the Ocean'). Judge T9 on CTR and AVD once it has 500 or more impressions before reusing it.
thumbnail_brief: Archetype C hero: one huge, hard-eyed orca (open jaw, no smile curve, powerful, never cute) breaching across a flat steel-blue background with a whole great white held side-on in its mouth (no blood, no wound, no red), and tiny Doug in a small rowboat beside it, waving, while the orca's eye looks away from him; text 'NOT ME?' at most, and never a title or alt-title word (Why, Orcas, Orca, Kill, Everything, Ocean, Except, Doug, You, Every, Animal, One, Won't, Creepiest, Habit, Scientists, Found, Feeding, People, Most, Disturbing, Hunts, Part); for the B test, the 3x3 grid of eight prey tiles labelled SALMON / OTTER / SEAL / DOLPHIN / STINGRAY / MOOSE / GREAT WHITE / BLUE WHALE with a ninth tile of Doug in the boat labelled 80 KG.
description:
Orcas hunt salmon, sea otters, stingrays, moose, great white sharks, whale sharks and even blue whales, the largest animals that have ever lived. Yet wild orcas have no confirmed record of killing a person. Doug dresses as each of their prey to find out why people are not on the killer whale menu.

What should Doug dress up as next? Tell us in the comments.
Subscribe so you don't miss Doug's next bad costume.
